name: Missha All Around Safe Block Waterproof Sun Milk SPF50+/PA+++ (70ml)
description:
Product Name: Missha All Around Safe Block Waterproof Sun Milk
Volume: 70ml
SPF/PA Rating: SPF50+ / PA+++

Key Features

High-Performance Sun Protection: Shields skin from harmful UVA & UVB rays

Waterproof & Sweat-Resistant: Stays effective during swimming, outdoor activities, or sweating

Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Comfortable for all-day wear

Hydrating Formula: Keeps skin smooth and moisturized

Soft Matte Finish: Perfect as a base for makeup

Ideal for Active Lifestyles: Long-lasting protection for sports, beach, or outdoor adventures
